caseName: M.J. v. Wash. Univ. in St. Louis Physicians
caseNameFull: M.J. v. WASHINGTON UNIVERSITY IN ST. LOUIS PHYSICIANS

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioner allowed until January 5, 2015, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
